major_cooldowns.name: Ascendance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it two globals into the pull, then cast Crash Lightning whenever it is ready and Windstrike every other GCD while Thorim's Invocation spends your Maelstrom Weapon.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 114051 is the id seen both as cast and self aura; 114050 and 114052 share the name and were not observed. Table base cooldown is 180s, the guide's 120s assumes Thorim's Invocation is taken.

major_cooldowns.name: Doom Winds
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it off the GCD straight into Primordial Storm, then weave Lava Lash with Crash Lightning and Stormstrike so Thorim's Invocation keeps discharging.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 384352 is the 60s button (4 casts in the one Totemic parse); 469270 shares the name with 232 casts and is the triggered effect, 466772 is the buff aura. Guide's 10s duration assumes Thorim's Invocation, tooltip base is 8s.

major_cooldowns.name: Surging Totem
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it every minute and immediately run Sundering, Lava Lash, then Doom Winds with Primordial Storm to burn its Whirling motes.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base cooldown reads 25s; the guide states the cooldown is now 60s with the 25s duration retained. 1221348 shares the name and is not the button.

major_cooldowns.name: Sundering
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it every 30 seconds without drifting off the Surging Totem timer so its Surging Elements haste and the Primordial Storm window land on your cooldowns.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 197214 is the button; 467283 shares the name with 52 casts in a single parse and tracks the extra Splitstream hits.

major_cooldowns.name: Primordial Storm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it inside your Doom Winds window at full Maelstrom Weapon, since it consumes and scales with every stack you hold.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1218090 is the cast id, 1218125 the buff aura, 1218047 the talent id the guide cites. The 30s cadence is Sundering's, which grants the 15s window.

defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into a known heavy hit or a stretch of rot damage to cut what lands on you.
defensives.id_note: 108271 is the cast and aura seen in parses; 292158 shares the name and was not observed.

defensives.name: Stone Bulwark Totem
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it just before a big hit for an absorb that keeps refreshing while the totem lives.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Ancestral Guidance
defensives.usage_rule: Turn it on when raid damage is going out during a burst window so your damage heals you and the group.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Healing Stream Totem
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it through raid damage for a steady trickle of healing that costs you nothing.
defensives.id_note: 5394 is the summon cast; 426214 shares the name and neither id was observed in the sampled parses.

defensives.name: Spirit Link Totem
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it on the group for a spike of raid damage to share health pools and soften the hit.
defensives.id_note: 98008 is the summon cast; 325174 is the aura seen in one parse.

defensives.name: Earth Elemental
defensives.usage_rule: Summon it to soak a hit or pull a loose add off you.

rules.description: Open Voltaic Blaze, Stormstrike, Ascendance, Windstrike
rules.action: Open with Voltaic Blaze and one Stormstrike, then press Ascendance and fill with Windstrike.

rules.description: Spend Lightning Bolt at full Maelstrom Weapon
rules.action: Pool Maelstrom Weapon to full before pressing Lightning Bolt outside your cooldown windows.

rules.description: Tempest is your spender while its proc is up
rules.action: Send Tempest instead of Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning whenever the proc is sitting on you.

rules.description: Lava Lash over Stormstrike during Hot Hand
rules.action: Press Lava Lash on cooldown inside Hot Hand and keep Stormstrike as the filler between them.

rules.description: Keep Flame Shock on your target
rules.action: Reapply Flame Shock the moment it drops so Ashen Catalyst cooldown reduction and Voltaic Blaze keep working.

rules.description: Keep the Crash Lightning buff rolling
rules.action: Press Crash Lightning as soon as its buff falls off so your strikes keep cleaving.
Press Voltaic Blaze right before you pop Ascendance so Burning Core is already rolling.

rules.description: Primordial Storm right after Doom Winds
rules.action: Trigger Doom Winds off the GCD and go straight into Primordial Storm for its three Windfury hits.
Follow every Surging Totem with Sundering to spend Whirling Earth and layer its haste.

rules.description: Primordial Storm at full Maelstrom Weapon
rules.action: Hold Primordial Storm until Maelstrom Weapon is full unless its window is about to expire.

rules.description: Chain Lightning as your AoE spender
rules.action: Switch your Maelstrom Weapon spender from Lightning Bolt to Chain Lightning once extra targets are up.

source_summary: Enhancement pours its damage into one window: Stormbringer opens straight into Ascendance and races Crash Lightning and Windstrike while Thorim's Invocation spends Maelstrom Weapon for you, while Totemic chains Surging Totem into Sundering, Doom Winds and Primordial Storm every minute. Sundering stays on its 30 second cooldown so the Surging Elements haste and the Primordial Storm window layer over those cooldowns, and Voltaic Blaze goes out just before each window to have Burning Core rolling. Outside cooldowns you pool Maelstrom Weapon to full and spend it on Tempest when it procs, on Lightning Bolt in single target and on Chain Lightning in AoE.
